deferred.l2s: User requested waiting for official implementation; repository contains only README.md.

baseline: Rerun the original baseline under the same 100-epoch cap and patience=10; retain old 20-epoch results as history
split: Original frozen Kvasir 880 training / 120 validation; test.txt equals val.txt
checkpoint_selection: Maximum per-image foreground IoU on the same 120 images; >= tie chooses later epoch
evaluation: 352x352, sigmoid in FP32, threshold >0.5, foreground per-image average, smoothing=1
scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=100, eta_min=0); step after training before validation
loss: Frozen baseline StructureLoss_binary; main + aux_d2 + aux_d3, each weight 1; boundary weight 0

implementation_adaptations.polyper: Pinned author's Swin and decoder; vectorized spatial indexing and query chunks of 256 preserve the attention equation and original no_grad branch. CPU-double outputs and gradients checked against author's implementation.
implementation_adaptations.eat: Pinned author's DCNv4 projections and network. DCNv4 sampling implemented with deterministic autograd gather, checked against independent grid_sample forward/backward and finite differences, including GPU repeatability. Native shallow DFConv stays inactive: zero unnormalized masks and zero biases feed BN/ReLU with zero derivative. Confirmed using the original DFConv class with both sampling backends and a GELU positive control; architecture and initialization retained. All three APM deformable coordinate/mask gradients must be nonzero.
implementation_adaptations.condseg: Global adaptive max pool replaced by equivalent deterministic flatten/max with first-maximum tie gradient. Activation checkpointing preserves BatchNorm buffers and RNG; observed six-step losses equal the uncheckpointed smoke.
implementation_adaptations.asgnet: Pinned author's PVTv2-B3 network; FFT input explicitly FP32 under BF16, equivalent global max pooling for strict CUDA. No native edge loss is added.

head_mapping.polyper: Native final segmentation supplied to all three baseline loss slots (3*Structure); no invented auxiliary heads
head_mapping.eat: Native final segmentation supplied to all three baseline loss slots (3*Structure); released zero-initialized BN/ReLU shallow DFConv remains inactive, as verified with an independent sampling oracle
head_mapping.condseg: Native final mask logit, native foreground auxiliary logit, negative native background auxiliary logit; uncertainty mask head has no dedicated loss under the fixed baseline recipe
head_mapping.asgnet: Native final f1, f2 and f3 segmentation logits; native boundary outputs receive no added boundary loss

polyper.protocol: 900 Kvasir + 550 ClinicDB training; Kvasir test 100; 224 crops, 80k iterations; released evaluator uses accumulated class statistics and default sigmoid threshold 0.3; table-generation settings not fully established

eat.protocol: README 80/10/10; released loader 80/20; Kvasir mIoU greater than Dice needs clarification; not a validated comparable target

condseg.protocol: Kvasir 880/120 (matching image membership not established), 256 input, consistency pretraining then task-specific training; this controlled study does not add their training strategy or losses

asgnet.protocol: 900 Kvasir + 550 ClinicDB training; Kvasir test 100; PVTv2-B3, native multi-output and edge training

l2s.protocol: Five-fold cross validation, 448 input; deferred by user until official code is published
